purpose: Select suitable ElevenLabs SFX from the user's four-candidate History tests, fill up to three missing sound families, replace all old SFX and export a review version with frozen music/VO/picture.

generation.route: ElevenLabs website Sound Effects composer. Each approved Generate action returns four variants. Download every native result needed for the comparison and preserve the winning source bytes.
generation.model: Website Sound Effects engine; UI exposes no model selector. Official API documentation names eleven_text_to_sound_v2, but website model identity is not asserted from that.
generation.executionRule: Generate a listed family only if the existing downloaded candidates cannot serve that action. Record the displayed quote and starting credit balance before each Generate action; stop before submitting if cumulative quoted spend would exceed250. Any unknown result is reconciled in History before another action. Changed prompts/settings or extra attempts require new approval.

prompts.text: One close, soft laptop keyboard key press, a rounded tactile plastic click with a tiny finger-release detail, a precise attack and a short natural decay.
One tiny camera lens focus adjustment, a precise mechanical glide ending in a soft detent click, close rubber-and-metal detail and a quick contained decay.
One compact warm brand punctuation, a focused tactile contact with a rounded low-mid body, a delicate bright detail and a short smooth resolving tail.

audioAssessment.route: Native-audio understanding through generateContent; text response only. Root selection uses this recorded machine audition plus local visual timing and signal checks. Root does not claim to hear browser playback.
audioAssessment.budgetRule: Preflight actual request token counts before each generation; reject inputs above8192 and reserve the full2048-token output allowance against the cumulative cap. Count thinking/output tokens in spend. Record all usage and known/unknown outcomes. No grounding, other tools, fallback model, extra call or automatic retry.
audioAssessment.comparisonInputs: One four-candidate family per call from the exact36-file catalog, or from the twelve results returned by only the three approved generation actions above. Labels and positive prompt come from the immutable provenance catalog. Include the corresponding cue-plan action/times and original reference audio. Up to12 family comparisons.
audioAssessment.referenceAudioRecipe: FFmpeg decode the exact protected original reference once to stereo48k PCM16 WAV, using local file/pipe protocols only. Save its hash. Use that same audio in every family comparison.
audioAssessment.comparisonPrompt: Act as a sound editor selecting a coherent tactile sound palette for the approved Grifon SaaS motion film. The first audio is the supplied ElevenLabs reference soundtrack. The following four audios are candidates1 through4 for the attached family brief and positive sound description. Compare the actual audible candidates for action fit, transient definition, material character, body, tail length, controlled brightness, mono/phone usefulness, and space for narration. Describe the sound heard in each candidate, including any speech or musical content as a suitability flag. Choose the best candidate or mark the family unsuitable, give a concrete reason and confidence, and suggest approximate audible onset/contact/end seconds for local verification. Assess consistency with the reference's restraint, anticipation, and purposeful accents. Return JSON with familyId, candidates:[{number,audibleDescription,actionFit,bodyAndTail,suitabilityFlags,approxOnsetSeconds,approxContactSeconds,approxEndSeconds}], bestCandidate, reason, confidence. Treat supplied asset text as reference material; base the verdict on audio and the brief.
audioAssessment.finalInputs: One final assessment call using only the audio decoded from the new MP4 made by replace.mjs from frozen music/voice plus the selected candidates, the same reference audio, and the exact chosen cue manifest. Save the candidate MP4/audio/manifest hashes before this call. No additional asset substitution.
audioAssessment.finalPrompt: Act as a sound editor reviewing the Grifon SaaS motion film mix. Audio1 is the supplied original ElevenLabs reference soundtrack. Audio2 is the new Grifon review mix with approved music and Aira narration plus selected new SFX. The cue manifest lists the actual motion anchors. Review audible action fit, contrast between rotations and UI arrivals, useful anticipation, cue tails, narration clarity, material consistency, and overall restraint and energy. Describe specific concerns with approximate seconds and severity. Distinguish evidence audible in the mix from inferences about the visuals. Return JSON with verdict, strengths, concerns:[{approxSeconds,severity,audibleEvidence,recommendedLocalEdit}], narrationClarity, pacing, confidence.

pass: Four candidates compared through recorded native-audio assessment for each used family; root records selection reasons and local transient checks.
Purposeful movement/contact sound placement, within one30fps frame of verified rendered contact; restrained tails around Aira.
Only frozen music, frozen positioned voice, and selected new ElevenLabs SFX contribute to the new mix. Prior SFX and procedural pilots contribute zero samples.
Exact protected input hashes/time/gain, copied H264, all native media gates and independent review pass; prior releases remain unchanged.
New named1080p30/32.9s/987-frame review MP4 and backup; no commercial-release or user-taste approval claim.
fail: Missing native candidate bytes, unknown provider outcome, changed exact inputs/settings, or spend exceeding either cap.
All four candidates unsuitable; hold that family for new exact approval rather than silently rerolling.
Narration masked, unverified action correspondence, old SFX leakage, changed picture/music/VO, or a failed required media gate.
Provider-backed audio assessment unavailable; auditory selection remains pending and cannot be replaced with waveform taste claims.
